title: Events alert — 2026-11-14
body: **Nvidia Q3 FY27 earnings — Tue Nov 17, ~4:20 pm ET (22:20 Berlin); call 5:00 pm ET (23:00 Berlin).** Consensus: EPS ~$2.47 on ~$108.8B revenue (company guide $108B ±2%), gross margin ~74% ±50bp, assuming zero China data-center revenue. This is the first print with CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO after Huang's Nov 12 resignation, so guidance credibility matters as much as the beat. Read-through by sleeve: semis (AVGO, MU, MRVL, AMD) and infrastructure (VRT, ANET, SMCI, DELL) gap with NVDA's Q4 guide — a soft guide hits the whole capex chain; power/utilities (CEG, VST, TLN, ETN, GEV) hold unless capex is explicitly cut. With uncertainty this high into the print, the cash sleeve is the hedge — no new chain entries Monday/Tuesday. No verified macro releases due Nov 14–16.
